name: xero
summary: Official-first Xero MCP/CLI plugin with local user OAuth, rate governance, finance-rule helpers, and optional CDP reconciliation finalization.
state_owner: Xero plugin assembly and local credential/runtime environment; committed repo state is docs, manifests, generic MCP/tool code, and reusable rule schemas only.
judgement_owner: Human finance operator owns accounting judgement; deterministic connector code owns API surface, OAuth boundaries, rate governance, dedup checks, and output shape.
deterministic_validators: future live Xero auth smoke validation
future live Xero MCP read-only smoke validation
future live Xero governor header smoke validation
provider_boundary: Providers may summarize retrieved accounting data but must not receive secrets, MFA material, cookies, or organization-specific credential names.
domain_boundary: Xero Accounting API, local OAuth, accounting objects, reports, reusable finance-rule helpers, and optional already-authenticated CDP workflow guidance.
stop_conditions: credentials and tenant-private exports stay out of commits
generic code remains separated from private organization-specific configuration
read/write capability boundaries are documented before use
browser automation does not package login, MFA retrieval, credential entry, or security-control bypass behavior
data_boundary: Do not commit tokens, client secrets, MFA codes, cookies, browser profiles, tenant-private exports, private organization-specific account mappings, or local credential item names as defaults.
